title: The Inv. Hrs green/red coloring appears on screen and in the PDF only — the CSV is monochrome
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Inv. Hrs column is on and the current tab includes positive and negative Inv. Hrs values.
custom_steps:
1. Download the current tab as a PDF and look at the Inv. Hrs values' coloring.
2. Download the current tab as a CSV and inspect the Inv. Hrs values.
custom_expected:
1. In the PDF, Inv. Hrs keeps the green (positive) / red (negative) coloring.
2. In the CSV, the Inv. Hrs column is monochrome — plain signed numbers with no color or markup.
